Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, PKL wrote:
> One stupid quiz, which I think have been posted earlier, anyway; Is
> "fortune teller" cumulative? I think it must be since it is neither unique
> nor marked with a non-cumulative text. Just sounds too good... 3-4, or
> even seven "fortune tellers" should do the day then. Though I guess my
> prey would become pretty desperate to block.

Yes. With X Fortune Tellers, you can consecutively look at 1 card at random
from your Prey's hand X times. Each 1 card is chosen at random, so you have
the possibility of choosing the same 1 card more than once.
